load_olmo_tokenizer: load an OLMo tokenizer from a HuggingFace model path with configurable EOS token for base or chat models
create_OLMOTokenizer_encoder: create a token encoder from an OLMOTokenizer with modes like default, prompt, prompt_response, or as_is
create_OLMOTokenizer_raw_encoder: create a raw token encoder from an OLMOTokenizer without prefix or suffix tokens
create_OLMOTokenizer_decoder: create a token decoder from an OLMOTokenizer with optional special token skipping
get_OLMOTokenizer_vocab_info: get the vocabulary information from an OLMOTokenizer including token counts and special tokens
